name: comparator-offset-cm-window
description: SUPPLEMENTAL (issue #182): same-draw Monte-Carlo preamp offset and gain at the consumer's three input common modes, dut_vcm - 100 mV / dut_vcm / dut_vcm + 100 mV, from ONE nested dc sweep of ONE instance per draw.
claim: SUPPLEMENTAL CHARACTERIZATION, NOT A VERDICT. No ratified row backs this bench and none is created by it: the README target table has no CMRR row and the consumer's rejection verdict in spec/consumers.md stays Unknown. It is separately named so that sim/comparator-offset-mc/ (its standalone +/-50 mV band and every historical record) is untouched. NO RECORD EXISTS: the fleet path is refused by sim/tools/mk_klt_request.py and sim/tools/klt_record.py with UNSUPPORTED_EXECUTOR_CAPABILITY (see this experiment's README.md), and the local control loop below was not run when it landed. Schematic preamp DC only -- not whole-comparator transient, not extracted-layout common-mode rejection.

sig_vos_mid_mv.description: MISMATCH-ON GUARD, not a spec bound -- the same floor and reason as sim/comparator-offset-mc/'s sig_vos_mv: a deck whose local mismatch failed to turn on reports ~0 here while everything else still looks plausible.

av_sigma_pct.description: DRAW-PRESERVATION DIAGNOSTIC, not proof of identity. Gain at each common mode is (dv(+2 mV) - dv(0)) / 2 mV from ONE dc sweep; if the draw were re-rolled between sweep points the gain would scatter by tens of percent. The identity argument itself is structural (one instance, one analysis, one draw per loop iteration) -- see this experiment's README.md.

evidence.mc_seed: Local control loop: ngspice `setseed 20260909` then 200 draws per PVT point through `dowhile`/`reset`, exactly as sim/comparator-offset-mc/. Fleet path (when supported): klt sim monte_carlo {n: 200, seed: 20260909, vary: mismatch}, one deck and one `.options seed=` per draw. Equal seeds across separate requests are NOT draw identity; the six points of a draw must come from one analysis of one instance.
evidence.mc_scope: mismatch-only (sw_stat_mismatch = 1 set by the fragment, sw_stat_global left at the PDK default 0); global process variation is the corner axis.
evidence.mc_sigma: Per draw and per common mode p in {dn, mid, up}: A_v,p = (dv_p(+2 mV) - dv_p(0)) / 2 mV and V_os,p = -dv_p(0) / A_v,p; the paired deltas are V_os,dn - V_os,mid and V_os,up - V_os,mid within the SAME draw. Means and population standard deviations are taken over the draws.
notes: SUPPLEMENTAL AND UNSCORED. There is no ratified CMRR bound; the consumer's rejection verdict stays Unknown until a decision record says otherwise.
FULL 45-POINT COVERAGE IS PENDING. No record of this bench exists; see README.md for the executor capability gap and the next step.

WHAT THIS IS NOT. Schematic preamp DC offset vs common mode: not whole-comparator transient behaviour, not extracted-layout common-mode rejection, and it carries no load-resistor mismatch (the PDK models none; see sim/comparator-offset-mc/).
